title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E9 — My Achy Breaky Back
In order to go on an important coaching interview after he hurts his back, Mark undergoes some experimental treatment for the pain at the doctor's office where Vanessa works. Series director Mark Linn-Baker ("Perfect Strangers") guest stars.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E20 — The Robbing Hood
Moesha and Hakeem explore their evolving dating relationship.  Dorian visits Moesha on campus and Moesha sees this as a chance to forge a sister/brother relationship; items begin missing from dorm rooms and all clues lead towards Dorian.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E21 — Arriving Right On Q
Moesha and Hakeem’s relationship hits a snag when Q returns to town; sparks fly between Moesha and Q;  Q invites Moesha to spend the summer (as a road manager) on tour with his rap group.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E22 — D-Money Loses His Patience
Hakeem tries to convince Moesha to pass on Q’s offer to go on the road with his band, and focus on her priorities: school, family, and him.  Moesha admits to being too distracted to make a clear decision.

title: Moesha
description:

Moesha and Q decide whether or not to take their relationship to the next level; Dorian returns home from boot camp.

description:
S3 E6 — THe Big No-So Loyal Family Episode
When Dee Dee realizes that Mona has become friends with a woman she has had a long history of competing against, she tells Mona that she has to choose between this new friend and her own sister.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E7 — The Big Don't Go Chasing Waterfalls Episode
To try to give his career a jumpstart, Spencer goes after signing a notorious bad-boy performer, but he has his hands full when the singer isn't as reformed as he led people to believe.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E8 — The Big My Life And Kids Episode
Dee Dee is torn when she gets a date with a great man whom she admires, but she discovers he is divorced with two kids. At first, she rejects the idea of dating him, but she reconsiders and has a great time with his family.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E9 — The Big Thanks For Nothing Episode
High drama occurs and secrets are revealed at Dee Dee's Thanksgiving party when Spencer's father, Ray, shows up unexpectedly. Mona comes clean to her father about her feelings of being slighted by him and Phyllis rethinks her relationship with Ray.
